#BlackLivesMatter is diverting my money from structures which support whiteness, but my attention too to support Black communities and creatives.This means passing the mic, connecting people up, unlearning need for validation from white ppl to "progress"

https://t.co/pRV8fn07Ax

Past month it has been asking people within my profession what are they doing to show that #BlackLivesMatter in a non-tokenistic way, especially centring the wellbeing of Black staff and young people who work in museums.

#BlackLivesMatter is listening and reflecting on different lived experiences of structural racism, especially with accessing services. It's also just not about having a London-centric understanding. This means reading more, changing my feed so I can learn from ppl doing the work.

#BlackLivesMatter is also examining and calling out problematic shit within the South Asian diaspora, going further than skin lightening creams, but caste and the history of antiblackness in our communities and histories of activism. 

Still more to do but intend to keep doing it
